atoms.text: Ruth wants to get some information about her local bus routes, so she can work out the gaps in the timetable.

elements: Bus 3 will leave Davenmine 40 minutes before it arrives in Slatteny.
Bus 1 will arrive in Millbrook one hour and 7 minutes after it leaves Davenmine.
Bus 4 will arrive in Bridgetown one hour and 51 minutes later than Bus 3.

instruction.text: There are some times missing from the timetable. Fill in the gaps using the information.

atoms.a: What time will Bus 3 arrive in Millbrook if it gets stuck in traffic for 16 minutes after leaving Slatteny?

atoms.sound: Ruth wants to get to Bridgetown from Millbrook by one o’clock. What is the latest bus she could take?
